verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a 'modern and flexible 3D renderer' with extensible shaders/materials/pipelines and note new contact shadows in 0.19, and community praise for overall engine quality exists, but the evidence never explicitly documents PBR material workflows, global illumination/baked lighting, or a post-processing stack, and one hands-on report calls early shadow quality 'jagged/low-res'. missing for 10: explicit PBR material system docs, GI/baked lighting support, dedicated post-processing pipeline docs, and independent corroboration of modern shadow/GI quality.
